@@
+Status: First implementation slice (PR); live acceptance pending
+
+agent.reaction is a factual classification after a Harn.x policy.decision BLOCK.
+It is not a response engine, not a security detection, and not a caused_by claim.
+Security interpretation remains behavior.detection with unchanged bars.
+
+ALTERNATE_TOOL requires different capability family AND exact/strong equivalence.
+Silence alone is never ASK_USER or STOP.
+Cursor ASK_USER/STOP support is incomplete — expect UNKNOWN often.
+Not a bypass claim; factual correlation only.

@@
+export const DEFAULT_REACTION_WINDOW_MS = 120_000
+const blockedReq = findBlockedToolRequest(events, block)
+const blockedNorm = normalizeAction(blockedReq)
+// policy-block → agent semantic reaction (harness-native)
+if (isAlternateTool(blockedNorm, laterNorm)) return { type: 'ALTERNATE_TOOL' }
+export function correlateAgentReaction() {}
+behavior.detection remains separate from agent.reaction
